verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says it integrates with Google and Outlook calendars, and that on-call schedules can live in a shared Google calendar. This points to calendar sync of on-call schedules, but the evidence never says it is a per-user subscribable feed. The shared-calendar wording reads more like an inbound way to define schedules than an outbound personal shift export. Missing for 10: a documented personal iCal/ICS subscription feed URL, confirmation that an individual's shifts (including overrides) are pushed to their own calendar, details on sync behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook

citations.quote: Manage on-call schedules from our built-in web interface or keep them in a shared Google calendar.
